receipt_policy.rule: A required artifact path, a prepared handoff, or a prior planning assertion is not an ACCEPTED receipt. Only the named owner and required evidence may change a gate to ACCEPTED.

gates.owner: Zack; B/C co-sign interface; A co-sign facts
gates.required_artifact: docs/approvals/b-decisions.json plus an approved PRODUCT-FREEZE.md commit
required_evidence: D01-D16 implementation-relevant items each state final choice, approver, time, verbatim approval/source, and affected files.
Already-approved H1=350 and four-endpoint facts may be cited but do not substitute for unresolved decisions.
Workbook SHA256, eight sheets/seven business-table names, column mapping, primary/foreign keys, ID storage types, time/null rules.
Five work-order classes and expected-count provenance.

gates.required_artifact: handoff/a/cases-manifest.json plus an A-accepted fixtures commit
required_evidence: Hero second contact at 09:32 and evaluation at 09:40, original message and augmentation provenance, alias-to-session mapping.
Product/gift/image-source associations and root fixture alignment to approved contract.

receipt.source: Product-owner clarification: X-A-FIXTURES accepted; the prior ground-truth SHA registration omitted one 0, while the delivered artifacts were unchanged.
receipt.verification_method: git show <sha>:<path> raw Git blob bytes, never worktree

prior_registration_error.classification: registration transcription error; delivered artifact unchanged

gates.required_artifact: handoff/a/images-manifest.json plus five original team images under frontend/public/evidence/ and independent injection-pair images
required_evidence: filename, evidence_id, source_message_id, SHA256, MIME, provenance/license, no-PII declaration, and reviewable human labels for every image.
Injection pairs retain the same base pixels; B and C reference the registered bytes, not placeholders.
gates.additional_observation: frontend/public/evidence/ contained README.md only during this check.

gates.owner: B and team compute owner; Zack approves cost/model changes
required_evidence: Actual qwen3-vl-plus revision, service address and call protocol, usage, region/device/dependency/license record, availability and warm-up record.
Secrets remain only in environment variables; keys, GPU/rental resources, network, and permissions are supplied by the team.

gates.owner: A authors; D receives; Zack approves policy semantics
required_evidence: Three demo truth records synchronized for conflicts and twenty development samples with provenance, input, expected result, evaluation definition, and hashes.
Ten holdout samples are separately delivered to D; the 20/10 split does not create thirty product scenarios.
TypeScript types and four endpoint examples aligned with BATCH-03, including A34, error mapping, model provenance, and constrained human_edits.
Actual npm test/build output, contract version, and request-example hashes.

gates.required_artifact: handoff/c/http-ui-ready.json plus a C UI repair commit
required_evidence: Notification drafts do not enter consumer chat until confirmation; retries retain an idempotency key and failures do not display success.
Events follow a selected legal timeline without backward time movement; HTTP mode renders backend cache/challenge/metrics/model-provenance state.
Ten independent holdout cases with hashes, provenance, human labels, and a frozen evaluation definition accessible only to independent evaluation.
No unapproved accuracy target and no label-based prompt tuning.
D has accepted independent-review input and records fixed integration SHA, environment, evidence paths, and a real-model availability window.
This is execution-readiness evidence only; formal G5/QA acceptance remains a post-review team-protocol outcome.
